Name: Quality Bundle
Author: Tara864
Description:
Quality Bundle
combine compatible items of different qualities into a single stack while preserving their original properties. It also supports merging different colors of the same flower species!
[heading]Features[/heading]
[list]
[*]Merge normal, silver, gold, and iridium-quality items into one inventory slot.[/*]
[*]Combine different colors of the same flower species.[/*]
[*]Preserve original item qualities, colors, and properties.[/*]
[*]Hover over a bundle to view and withdraw individual variants.[/*]
[*]Use familiar inventory controls, including right-clicking and the Organize button.[/*]
[*]Supports all 12 official Stardew Valley languages.[/*]
[*]Includes compatibility support for various vanilla interactions and other mods, though some integrations are still experimental.[/*]
[/list][heading]Installation[/heading]
[b]Requirements:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0+
Download the mod and extract it into your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.
[heading]Important Notes — Beta Version[/heading]
[b]This is my first attempt at creating a Stardew Valley mod![/b]
The mod was developed with the help of [b]ChatGPT (AI)[/b]. I'm still learning, and there may be bugs or unexpected compatibility issues.
[b]Testing status:[/b]
[list]
[*]Tested on Windows in single-player mode.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer has not been tested.[/*]
[*]macOS and Linux have not been tested.[/*]
[*]Compatibility with every other mod cannot be guaranteed.[/*]
[/list]Please back up your save files before using this mod, especially while it is in beta.
[b]Before uninstalling, make sure to withdraw all items from their bundles.[/b] Removing the mod while bundled items remain in your save may cause item loss.
[heading]Bug Reports & Feedback[/heading]
If you find a bug or discover that Quality Bundle doesn't work with another mod, [b]please let me know through the Bugs or Posts section![/b]
If possible, include your SMAPI log, the mod versions involved, and a description of how to reproduce the issue.
I'm happy to receive suggestions and compatibility reports, and I'll do my best to improve the mod.
Thank you for giving my first mod a try! ❤️
